High-cetane cracked diesel is made by mixing [[reformate|Reformate]] and [[cracked diesel|Cracked Diesel]]. It is used as a combustible [[fuel|Fuels]] source. It may also be [[hydrotreated|Hydrotreater]] to obtain [[high-cetane diesel|High-Cetane Diesel]].
